theorem residue_form₂ {α Q : ℝ} {a : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (h : Approx α a q Q) {y₁ y₂ : ℝ}
    (hy : 0 ≤ y₁) (hlen : y₂ - y₁ ≤ q) (hy₂ : y₂ ≤ Q / 2) {A C : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    ∃ τ : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ R, τ R ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2)) ∧
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊y₁⌋ ⌊y₂⌋,
          (if (q : ℤ) ∣ n then 0 else min A (C / Real.sin (π * α * n) ^ 2)) ≤
        ∑ R ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (q - 1), min A (C * fq q (R + τ R)) :=

note: Only the first bound 20Cq²/(3π²) is used downstream. Erratum: The proof's first display runs the integer-distance sum to r = q/2, but only r ≤ (q−1)/2 occur; for even q the extra term makes the display (2q²+1)C/3, which exceeds the next bound C·N(q) at q = 2, 4, 6 (3 > 2.363, 11 > 10.629, 24.333 > 24.146) and there even exceeds 20Cq²/(3π²) (checked by `scripts/checks/lemma_4_1_2.py`).
